restates_name: The description only restates the name ({words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}).
too_short: The description is too short ({words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}).
too_long: The description is long ({words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}). It helps selection but costs steps and tokens.
no_usage_context: Says nothing about when to use it, or when not to.
loose_string_param: String arguments with no constraint or example: {params}.
no_required: No `required` list, so every argument is optional.
params_not_in_description: The description mentions none of its 3 or more arguments.
vague_boolean: The meaning of the boolean argument {param} is unclear.
no_return_info: Says nothing about what it returns.
no_constraints: No constraints, side effects, auth or rate limits described, and no annotations.
destructive_unmarked: It may be destructive, but destructiveHint is not set.
generic_name: The name is made of generic words only.
bad_name_chars: The name contains characters other than letters, digits, _, - and .
deprecated: The description says the tool is deprecated. Name the replacement, and consider taking the tool out of tools/list: models avoid it when asked for what it does.
id_source_missing: Required identifiers whose description does not say where the value comes from: {params}. Name the tool or the place that returns it, or models look it up first.
too_many_tools: {count} tools. Above 40, models choose less accurately.
many_tools: {count} tools. Above 25, models start to tell tools apart less well.
confusable_pair: {a} and {b} have nearly the same description; only the names and schemas tell them apart. In each description, say when to use the other one instead.
confusable_pair_total: {total} pairs with nearly the same description in all; the top 12 are shown.
identical_description: These tools share the same description: {tools}.
repeated_note: {tools} tools repeat the same note ({words} words): "{excerpt}". Say it once in the server's instructions, and let each description say what only that tool does. The note does not count toward the tools' scores.
instructions_long: The server's instructions are {length} characters. Claude Code reads only the first {limit} by default (Codex 0.154.0 reads them whole). Put what the server is for first.
instructions_missing: The server has no instructions. Say there, once, what the server is for and when to use it: Claude Code and Gemini CLI read the instructions before the tool descriptions.
